title: Token Usage
markdown:
**What it is:** Cost and token accounting — a breakdown of where your AI spend is going.

**What it does:**

- Show total tokens and cost over all time or a date range.
- Break usage down by day and by model.
- Compare fresh input vs cached tokens, so you can see caching paying off.
- Drill into a single session's cost, turn by turn.

*Note: cached reads cost far less than fresh input — the system is built around caching to keep spend down. Lives under the Audit area in Settings.*
